title: Polemos — Codificación XML de la polémica gongorina (Labex OBVIL)
institution: La Polémica Gongorina project (Mercedes Blanco et al.), LabEx OBVIL, Sorbonne Université; TEI encoding under gongoradigital
notes: Polemos is the XML-TEI encoding of the 17th-century polémica gongorina (Jáuregui, Espinosa, Díez de Revenga texts, 1613-1630s) published for the Labex OBVIL; source XML files are in the gongoradigital organisation (polemos, polemos-naked). The 31 RQ texts (carta-amigo_1613, anti-jauregui, apologetico_1662, censura-lope...) match this edition. GitHub org and both repos verified live; the OBVIL reading site (obvil.sorbonne-universite.fr/corpus/gongora/polemos) refused connections from two networks at check time. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
